statement: Concurrent invocation of one call Cell actual never destroys healthy capacity: admission is bounded by a per-actual queue, overload is refused with a typed retryable backpressure result carrying preserveReplicaState so the lifecycle never projects the replica FAILED for contention, and cell health reflects parent-owned invocation state rather than a PING that a busy worker cannot answer — so two ordinary requests hashing to the same actual under normal load both complete without stopping the shared worker, and the cell-invocation-backpressure scenario is green.

constraints.statement: Concurrent invocation contention must never cause the service runtime lifecycle to project a replica FAILED; CONCURRENT_INVOCATION-class outcomes carry a preserveReplicaState marker through the driver stop path.
Reuse the existing WasmComponentDriver, ServiceRuntimeLifecycle, RuntimeDriverRegistry, and invocation routing owners; introduce no parallel worker pool, health monitor, or scheduler.
Overload is surfaced as a typed, retryable backpressure result through the canonical typed path, never as a generic failure or a silent drop.
If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
